name: Snoqualmie River (Fall City)
blurb: The Seattle-area summer tubing float below Snoqualmie Falls — short, warm(ish), and crowded on hot weekends.

sections.notes: Very popular with tubers; crowded on hot summer days. Discover Pass required at Plum Landing (WDFW).

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.
